name: PC Power Meter Pro
description:
PC Power Meter Pro turns a power sensor already exposed by iCUE into a deeper electricity and energy dashboard for XENEON Edge.

Choose one primary power sensor for the authoritative session. See live watts, a rolling graph, time weighted session average, observed peak, integrated Wh or kWh, today's measured energy and estimated electricity cost. Cost is calculated from the selected sensor's measured energy and your own electricity rate.

Session energy uses the actual elapsed milliseconds between valid readings and trapezoidal integration. Irregular samples are supported. Missing, disconnected and stale intervals are not filled with guessed power. Short widget restarts can resume a stored session without integrating the offline gap.

Pro keeps local daily energy buckets and a rolling history of finalized sessions. Set a graph window from 60 seconds to 10 minutes, configure a high power threshold and customize the main meter appearance.

The measurement label always follows the actual iCUE sensor metadata. CPU package power is not called total PC power. PSU input and output remain distinct. A whole system label is used only when iCUE exposes that scope.

Idle versus active is intentionally not claimed in V1 because iCUE does not expose a universal workload state signal that would make the classification reliable across PCs.

No account, helper app or external service is required. All history stays local to the widget instance.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial Pro release. Primary measured power sensor, rolling graph, integrated session and daily energy, configurable electricity cost, local session history, 60 second through 10 minute graph windows, high power threshold, measured scope labeling, strict disconnect and reconnect continuity, and tuned layouts for all eight XENEON size and orientation combinations.
